title: ASEAN Observers Report Thai Observation Post Moved About 20 Metres Forward in Pursat
detail: ASEAN observers reported on November 5 that a Thai military observation post had moved roughly 20 metres forward of its previous position in Pursat province, and inspected a bombed bridge. Cambodia has also complained about razor wire in a checkpoint area in Thma Puok district and says nearly 8,000 checkpoint-area residents remain unable to return home; Thailand disputes the figures, estimating about 4,600 across three communities it examined. Thai army chief visited the eastern border Nov 2-3 and ordered contingency readiness plans.

media.caption: ASEAN observers inspect bombed bridge and report forward Thai post
